name: Stratagem
description: Your tactical mission begins here. Strategize across the battlefield, plan each turn carefully, and outmaneuver your opponents. I joined the development team and worked directly on the game's code.

name: VaultByte
description: A secure storage mission awaits. VaultByte was built as an Android application focused on keeping data stored safely on the device.

name: JNOTALY
description: Every adventurer needs a way to prepare. JNOTALY is my first solo project, transforming engineering review notes into structured reviewers and quizzes so students can study and test their knowledge.

name: Patutim
description: Survival is the objective. Manage your resources, plan each move, and navigate the grid carefully if you want to make it through.

name: Room Management System
description: Your assignment: keep the rooms in order. Manage bookings, check availability, and prevent scheduling conflicts before they become a problem.

name: Book Management System
description: The library needs an organized keeper. Track books, manage inventory, and keep availability under control through this web-based system.

name: GUI Calculator
description: A simple calculation quest. Enter your numbers, perform the required operations, and let the interface handle the rest.

name: GUI Vending Machine
description: An old guild project from my Grade 11 days. This vending machine simulation uses a graphical interface to recreate the process of selecting and purchasing an item.

name: Networking Projects
description: Enter the network lab. Configure Cisco devices, build your topologies, and put your networking knowledge to the test.
